concerns.text: FR-001 and FR-002 require generating graph objects and feature vectors for every document. Tasks T016a (write graphs.json) and T016b (write features.csv) are marked incomplete [ ]. Without these tasks, the pipeline produces no verifiable output artifacts for US1, leaving the core 'Graph Construction' story unfulfillable.

FR-004 requires simulating retrieval ranking and calculating Recall@k. Tasks T022 (TF-IDF ranking implementation) and T023 (extracting signatures from retrieved docs) are marked incomplete [ ]. This prevents the execution of the critical comparison between graph-based and neural-based retrieval, making US2 untestable.

FR-005 and FR-006 mandate Spearman correlation and paired t-tests. Tasks T029a/b (t-test implementation), T031 (final metrics write), and T032 (validation status) are marked incomplete [ ]. This leaves SC-001, SC-003, and SC-005 unmeasurable, rendering the project's primary success criteria unattainable.

FR-007 requires enforcing a strict 6-hour time budget. Task T008b (timer.py and timeout enforcement) is marked incomplete [ ]. Without this, the CI constraint cannot be guaranteed, violating the resource constraint requirement.

The spec and plan require handling documents with <5 unique terms (edge case). While T010 (unit test) is complete, T011 (integration test for full sample) is incomplete [ ]. Without T011, there is no task ensuring the fallback logic works in a realistic pipeline scenario, leaving the edge case handling unverified.

SC-004 requires measuring computational resource usage (RAM) against CI constraints. Task T030 only mentions calculating 'wall-clock time' and 'latency reduction'. There is no specific task to log or verify peak RAM usage (7GB limit), leaving SC-004 unaddressed.
